changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO trades (trade_ref, instrument_id, counterparty_id, quantity, price, asset_class, side, trade_date, status) SELECT 'TRD-2026-' || LPAD(n::TEXT, 6, '0'), 1 + (n % 50), 1 + (n % 10), ROUND((random() * 10000 + 1)::NUMERIC, 4), ROUND((random() * 500 + 1)::NUMERIC, 4), (ARRAY['EQUITY','FIXED_INCOME','FX','COMMODITY','DERIVATIVE'])[1 + (n % 5)], 'SIDE' , DATE '2026-04-01' + (n % 120) * INTERVAL '1 day', (ARRAY['PENDING','MATCHED','UNMATCHED','DISPUTED','MATCHED','MATCHED'])[1 + (n % 6)] FROM generate_series(1, 500) AS n;
INSERT INTO recon_breaks (trade_id, trade_date, discrepancy_type, status) SELECT id, trade_date, (ARRAY['PRICE_MISMATCH','QUANTITY_MISMATCH','DATE_MISMATCH'])[1 + (id % 3)], 'OPEN' FROM trades WHERE status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED') LIMIT 30;

INSERT INTO trades (trade_ref, instrument_id, counterparty_id, quantity, price, asset_class, side, trade_date, status) SELECT 'TRD-2026-' || LPAD(CAST(n AS VARCHAR), 6, '0'), 1 + MOD(n, 50), 1 + MOD(n, 10), ROUND(RAND() * 10000 + 1, 4), ROUND(RAND() * 500 + 1, 4), CASE MOD(n, 5) WHEN 0 THEN 'EQUITY' WHEN 1 THEN 'FIXED_INCOME' WHEN 2 THEN 'FX' WHEN 3 THEN 'COMMODITY' ELSE 'DERIVATIVE' END, 'SIDE', DATEADD('DAY', MOD(n, 120), DATE '2026-04-01'), CASE MOD(n, 6) WHEN 0 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 1 THEN 'MATCHED' WHEN 2 THEN 'UNMATCHED' WHEN 3 THEN 'DISPUTED' ELSE 'MATCHED' END FROM SYSTEM_RANGE(1, 500) AS generated(n);
INSERT INTO recon_breaks (trade_id, trade_date, discrepancy_type, status) SELECT id, trade_date, CASE MOD(id, 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'PRICE_MISMATCH' WHEN 1 THEN 'QUANTITY_MISMATCH' ELSE 'DATE_MISMATCH' END, 'OPEN' FROM trades WHERE status IN ('UNMATCHED', 'DISPUTED') LIMIT 30;
